intro.fr: Inazuma Eleven GO Chrono Stones a un randomizer, Pixzer, depuis 2022.
intro.en: Inazuma Eleven GO Chrono Stones has had a randomizer, Pixzer, since 2022.

text.fr: LEVEL-5 sort Inazuma Eleven GO Chrono Stones, en deux versions (Wildfire et Thunderflash), sur Nintendo 3DS en 2012.
text.en: LEVEL-5 releases Inazuma Eleven GO Chrono Stones, in two versions (Wildfire and Thunderflash), on Nintendo 3DS in 2012.

text.fr: Le randomizer Pixzer est mis en ligne sur MediaFire le 19 avril 2022 ; l'assistance passe par le serveur Discord de Victory Road.
text.en: The Pixzer randomizer is uploaded to MediaFire on April 19, 2022; support goes through the Victory Road Discord server.
